player_prompt.intro:
I ka fɔli Countdown jɛri jɛɛrɛ!
Jɛɛrɛ: Kɛnɛ nambari wɛrɛw la, +, -, *, / nafa ka tɛgɛ tɛrɛmɛ.
Kɛlɛ format: [i j op] kɔrɔ i,j nambari dɔrɔnɔw la, op kɔrɔ ɲɛmɔgɔ.
Sɔgɔma: [0 2 *] kɛrɛ nambari kɔnɔ index 0 la, nambari kɔnɔ index 2 la.
Kɛlɛ tɛmɛnɛnɛ bɛɛ ka ca ni sɔrɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛlɛ format bɛɛ ka ca ni. Kɛrɛ `[i j op]` kɔrɔ i,j nambari dɔrɔnɔw la, op kɔrɔ +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: A ka kan ka kɛ cogoya wɛrɛ ye ani a be se ka tɛmɛ 0-{max_index} fɛ.
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Baara min tɛ bɛn ni sariya ye (fara 0 ma walima a laban ka kɛ nimɔrɔ dantigɛbali dɔ ye)

outcome.win: A ka ɲi! An ye an ɲɛɛ jɔlen sɔrɔ: {target}
